criteria.text: Only a necessary-before needs choice may create a dependency in the supplied direction; other classifications do not automatically become dependencies.
An explicitly selected existing Class parent may receive the selected sub-issue; an unsupported duplicate effect is reported without claiming success.
Existing links, human removals, graph cycles, ownership, incomplete observations and uncertain mutation outcomes are respected.

cases.given: A validated needs proposal explicitly selects a dependent and necessary blocker
cases.required_observation: The native dependency is created in the selected direction only after existing graph and ownership checks.

cases.given: A validated explicit sub-issue choice names an existing Class parent
cases.required_observation: The selected child is linked through the existing native pathway with readback.

cases.given: A validated duplicate choice names endpoints and direction
cases.required_observation: It is reported unsupported until a documented native mutation and safe readback exist; no substitute link is made.

cases.given: Self link, cycle, unknown graph, live foreign owner or confirmed human removal
A mutation has an unknown result
cases.required_observation: The batch stops and does not blindly resend; confirmed earlier results remain visible.
